post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.

patch.description: Partial edit of the caller's channel: nickname, name and description. Changing the nickname changes the public address, with no redirect.

400.description: Empty body, unknown field or invalid value (VALIDATION_ERROR), or reserved nickname (NICKNAME_RESERVED)

409.description: Nickname already used by another channel (NICKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS)

get.description: Every video of the caller's channel, in any status, newest first (created_at, then id), paginated. `views`, `likes` and `comments` are always 0 until Phases 05 and 06. There is no channel parameter and no filter.
Public page of a channel by its nickname: name, description, creation date and the number of published public videos. Never the id, user id or e-mail.

429.description: Too many requests (public-read limit per IP)

get.description: Published public videos of the channel, newest first (published_at, then id), paginated. Unlisted videos and drafts never appear here.

200.description: A page of the public listing

429.description: Too many requests (public-read limit per IP)

get.description: Categories maintained by the platform, ordered by name with `outros` last. The client uses the `slug` when editing a video.

429.description: Too many requests (public-read limit per IP)

post.description: Creates the video as a draft in the authenticated user's channel and opens the multipart upload in the object storage. The part size is defined by the server.

415.description: Extension or content type outside the allowlist (UNSUPPORTED_VIDEO_FORMAT)

get.description: Lists the parts already stored so an interrupted upload can be resumed. Only the owner of the video can call it; once the upload is completed the list of parts is empty.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

get.summary: Get the state of an upload

post.description: Issues presigned UploadPart URLs (valid for one hour) so the client sends each part straight to the object storage, without the bytes going through the API. Only the owner can call it, and only while the upload is not completed.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

400.description: Validation failed, or a part number beyond the parts of the declared size (INVALID_PART_NUMBER)

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

post.summary: Get presigned URLs for upload parts

post.description: Validates the uploaded parts, completes the multipart upload and queues the video for processing. Idempotent: repeating the call for an already completed upload returns the same answer without queuing another job.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

409.description: Parts missing, out of sequence or with an unexpected size (UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE)

413.description: Parts add up to more than 10 GiB; the draft is discarded (VIDEO_TOO_LARGE)

get.description: Metadata of a video, by its public identifier. A published video is readable by anyone; a draft only by the owner of its channel (anyone else gets 404). A video that is not `ready` is a 409, which only the owner reaches. The token is optional and only read from the `Authorization` header.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

404.description: Video not found, or a draft requested by someone other than the owner (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Video is still processing or in error, requested by the owner (VIDEO_NOT_READY)

patch.description: Partial edit of title, description, category (by slug) and visibility by the owner, in any processing status. An omitted field is not changed and `null` clears description or category; changing the visibility does not change `published_at`. The last write wins.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

400.description: Empty body, unknown field or invalid value (VALIDATION_ERROR), or unknown category slug (INVALID_CATEGORY)

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

post.description: Publishes a video that finished processing, `public` by default or `unlisted`. Every call writes `published_at` again (republishing refreshes it). Owner only.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

409.description: The video is not ready yet (VIDEO_NOT_PUBLISHABLE)

delete.description: Takes the video back to draft: anyone but the owner stops reading it. The visibility is kept. Idempotent (a draft also answers 204). Owner only.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

get.description: Serves the video file from the object storage without loading it into memory, under the same access rules as the metadata: a draft only for the owner (anyone else gets 404), then 409 while not `ready`. Supports a single-range `Range` header (206 Partial Content); any other `Range` value is ignored and the whole file is sent.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

206.description: The requested byte range, with a `Content-Range` header

404.description: Video not found, or a draft requested by someone other than the owner (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Video is still processing or in error, requested by the owner (VIDEO_NOT_READY)

get.description: Sends the whole video file as an attachment, streamed from the object storage without loading it into memory, under the same access rules as the metadata: a draft only for the owner (anyone else gets 404), then 409 while not `ready`.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

200.description: The video file, with a `Content-Disposition: attachment` header

404.description: Video not found, or a draft requested by someone other than the owner (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Video is still processing or in error, requested by the owner (VIDEO_NOT_READY)

get.description: Streams the video's cover: the owner's custom thumbnail if there is one, else the one generated by the worker. Same access rules as the metadata: a draft only for the owner (anyone else gets 404), then 409 while not `ready`.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

200.description: The cover as a JPEG (`Cache-Control: private, no-cache`)

404.description: Video not found, a draft requested by someone other than the owner, or a video without any cover (VIDEO_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Video is still processing or in error, requested by the owner (VIDEO_NOT_READY)

429.description: Too many requests (public-read limit per IP)

get.summary: Get the cover of a video

put.description: Replaces the cover with an image of the owner, in any processing status. The image is validated by its content (JPEG, PNG or static WebP, up to 2 MiB) and re-encoded as a JPEG 640 px wide, without metadata. The worker never overwrites it.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

file.description: JPEG, PNG or static WebP, up to 2 MiB

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or static WebP by its content, above the pixel limit, or undecodable (INVALID_IMAGE)

delete.description: Removes the custom cover, so the one generated by the worker is served again. Idempotent (a video without a custom cover also answers 204). Owner only.

parameters.name: public_id
parameters.description: Public identifier of the video (11 URL-safe characters)

403.description: The video belongs to another channel (VIDEO_ACCESS_DENIED)

nickname.description: `^[a-z0-9_]{3,50}$`, not reserved; changes the public address.

description.description: Up to 5,000 characters, plain text; `null` clears it.

filename.description: Original file name; the extension must be one of mp4, mov, mkv or webm.

content_type.description: Media type matching the extension, e.g. `video/mp4`.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes, from 1 up to 10 GiB.

upload_completed.description: True once the upload was confirmed as completed

uploaded_parts.description: Parts already in the storage (used to resume); empty once the upload is completed

part_numbers.description: Distinct part numbers to presign, from 1 to 10000 (up to 100 per call).

url.description: Presigned UploadPart URL; send the part bytes with PUT

expires_in.description: Validity of the URLs, in seconds

status.description: Still `draft`: the worker moves the video to `processing`

published_at.description: Null while the video is an editorial draft

description.description: Up to 5,000 characters, plain text; `null` clears it.
